references.text: Miriam is identified as Aaron's sister, and she is likely the same sister who stood watching Moses in the basket.
This verse mentions that Jochebed gave birth to Aaron, Moses, and their sister Miriam, confirming the identity of the sister who guarded Moses.
Miriam, Moses' sister, plays a central role in this narrative, demonstrating the enduring sibling bond from childhood.
Uses a similar Hebrew expression 'מֵרָחֹק' (from afar) to describe standing and watching a situation.
The prophet Micah mentions that God sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to lead Israel, confirming Miriam's significant role from the beginning.
A parallel between a sister observing from afar to see God's deliverance (Moses) and a disciple following from afar to see how the suffering ends (Peter).
